purpose: Provide a planning, evaluation, prioritization, and execution ontology for digital and performance marketing as a knowledge-searcher subdomain node: locate, retrieve, evaluate, and synthesize the work units, methods, and decision areas of inbound and paid channels, the funnel, conversion optimization, measurement, economics, and governance.
assumptions: Modeled as a subdomain node of Marketing & Growth for a knowledge-searcher meta-KB; nodes are concrete digital-marketing work units.
No observed dataset supplied; all numeric values are heuristic priors.

Scope spans inbound (SEO, content, email, organic social), paid (PPC, social/display, retargeting, creative, budget/bidding), funnel and CRO (A/B testing, landing pages, messaging), plus measurement, unit economics, and governance.
B2C and B2B digital marketing share this structure at the work-unit grain; channel specifics adapt within nodes.
exclusions: Offline/traditional advertising (TV, print, OOH) execution detail.
Product development, pricing strategy, and sales-team operations beyond marketing handoff.
Platform-specific UI click-paths and vendor tool tutorials.
Brand identity/visual design production beyond messaging and creative testing.

competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PERFORMANCE_ANALYTICS reads incrementality against the source of truth

glossary.definition: intent is the goal behind a query/visit; volume is how many people do it. Optimize for converting intent, not raw volume.
customer acquisition cost: total acquisition spend divided by customers acquired, ideally per channel and marginal.
lifetime value: the contribution margin a customer generates over their lifetime; the ceiling on affordable CAC.
the model assigning conversion credit across touchpoints; distinct from incremental causal impact.
the causal lift a channel produces versus a holdout; the true effect, not last-click credit.
a step in the journey (awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, revenue, referral) with its own conversion rate.
consistency between the ad/source promise and the landing page message it leads to.
return on ad spend: revenue (or contribution) per unit of ad spend; must be read against payback, not in isolation.
the probability a test detects a real effect of a given size; low power yields false winners.

evidence_label_policy.note: No observed/experimental inputs supplied; only heuristic labels are eligible.

source_registry.description: Heuristic priors from established digital and performance marketing practice and literature (Chaffey & Ellis-Chadwick 'Digital Marketing'; Ellis & Brown 'Hacking Growth'; standard SEO/PPC/CRO/lifecycle and growth-experimentation practice); no measured dataset supplied.
grounding_limits: all numeric values are heuristic priors, not measurements
no observed or experimentally_validated labels are eligible

edges.why_related: the primary KPI from the frame defines what measurement must track
edges.benefit_of_coupling: measurement tied to the real objective
edges.risk_of_conflict: measuring before the objective is set tracks the wrong KPI
edges.example: define conversions only after the brief names the primary KPI
edges.resolution_rule: fix the frame before the measurement plan

edges.why_related: the ICP scopes which audiences and intents are researched
edges.benefit_of_coupling: research bounded to the right audience
edges.risk_of_conflict: researching the wrong ICP wastes the demand map
edges.example: map intent for the ICP, not the whole market
edges.resolution_rule: scope research to the ICP from the brief

edges.why_related: positioning in the frame is the source of all messaging
edges.benefit_of_coupling: messages inherit one positioning
edges.risk_of_conflict: off-frame messaging fragments the brand
edges.example: derive value-prop variants from the brief positioning
edges.resolution_rule: set positioning in the frame before messaging

edges.why_related: the frame's audience and claims scope what governance must approve
edges.benefit_of_coupling: compliance scoped to the actual plan
edges.risk_of_conflict: ungoverned claims and tracking risk shutdowns
edges.example: review claims and consent for the planned audience
edges.resolution_rule: establish the frame before locking governance rules

edges.why_related: the measurement plan supplies the stage events the funnel model needs

edges.risk_of_conflict: modeling a funnel without events yields fictional rates

edges.resolution_rule: stand up measurement before the funnel model

edges.why_related: retention/LTV directly determines the CAC the business can afford
edges.benefit_of_coupling: spend ceilings reflect real retention
edges.risk_of_conflict: optimistic retention inflates affordable CAC
edges.example: feed measured retention into the LTV model
edges.resolution_rule: ground unit economics in observed retention

edges.why_related: retention strategy specifies the lifecycle flows email must execute
edges.benefit_of_coupling: email flows serve the retention plan
edges.risk_of_conflict: email blasts without a retention plan churn the list
edges.example: build flows from the retention plan
edges.resolution_rule: define retention strategy before lifecycle flows

edges.why_related: CAC/LTV ceilings set the CPA/ROAS targets bidding must respect
edges.benefit_of_coupling: bids capped at profitable thresholds
edges.risk_of_conflict: bidding past payback ceilings loses money at scale
edges.example: set CPA/ROAS targets from unit economics
edges.resolution_rule: compute unit economics before setting bid targets

edges.why_related: performance diagnosis supplies the channel costs and conversions economics needs
edges.benefit_of_coupling: CAC/LTV computed from reconciled data
edges.risk_of_conflict: economics on bad data misprices acquisition
edges.example: compute CAC from the reconciled performance data
edges.resolution_rule: reconcile reporting before computing economics

edges.why_related: performance diagnosis triggers reallocation of budget and bids
edges.benefit_of_coupling: budget tracks marginal return over time
edges.risk_of_conflict: stale reads lock budget to fading channels
edges.example: reallocate on the reconciled incrementality read; stop when within target band
edges.resolution_rule: reallocate on diagnosis but stop at the target band to avoid thrash

edges.why_related: experiment results must be read through reconciled analytics to be trusted
edges.benefit_of_coupling: wins confirmed on the source of truth
edges.risk_of_conflict: claiming wins on platform numbers misleads
edges.example: read experiment results on the analytics source of truth
edges.resolution_rule: reconcile analytics before crowning experiment wins

edges.why_related: governance bounds targeting, claims, and consent paid social may use
edges.benefit_of_coupling: campaigns stay policy- and law-compliant
edges.risk_of_conflict: non-compliant targeting/claims trigger bans or fines
edges.example: apply consent and claim rules to social campaigns
edges.resolution_rule: governance constraints override campaign aggressiveness

edges.why_related: consent and privacy rules bound who may be emailed and how
edges.benefit_of_coupling: email respects consent and opt-out
edges.risk_of_conflict: emailing without consent breaks law and deliverability
edges.example: gate flows on consent state
edges.resolution_rule: consent rules override list-growth pressure

edges.why_related: privacy/consent bounds the signals retargeting may use
edges.benefit_of_coupling: retargeting uses only consented signals
edges.risk_of_conflict: using non-consented signals risks legal action
edges.example: restrict audiences to consented signals
edges.resolution_rule: consent constraints override retargeting reach

edges.why_related: organic content and paid search compete for the same budget and intent capture
edges.benefit_of_coupling: balanced short- vs long-term demand capture
edges.risk_of_conflict: over-funding one starves the other's compounding/capture
edges.example: split budget by payback horizon: paid for immediate, content for compounding
edges.resolution_rule: fund paid for near-term targets and content for durable demand per the funnel diagnosis

edges.why_related: efficiency pressure to cut spend conflicts with reserving budget to test new creative
edges.benefit_of_coupling: sustained creative pipeline despite efficiency targets
edges.risk_of_conflict: cutting test budget for short-term ROAS causes future fatigue collapse
edges.example: reserve a fixed test budget share before efficiency cuts
edges.resolution_rule: protect a minimum creative-test budget; efficiency cuts apply to the remainder

edges.why_related: conversion-maximizing page copy can drift from on-brand positioning
edges.benefit_of_coupling: high conversion without brand erosion
edges.risk_of_conflict: over-optimized copy attracts wrong buyers and erodes brand
edges.example: positioning sets non-negotiable claims; CRO optimizes within them
edges.resolution_rule: positioning constraints dominate when a CRO win violates brand/claims

edges.why_related: aggressive targeting/claims that boost performance conflict with compliance limits
edges.benefit_of_coupling: performance within legal and policy bounds
edges.risk_of_conflict: chasing performance past compliance risks bans and fines
edges.example: compliance red lines are hard limits over performance gains
edges.resolution_rule: governance dominates: never breach consent/claim red lines for performance

edges.why_related: pressure to scale acquisition spend conflicts with fixing retention first
edges.benefit_of_coupling: spend scales on a non-leaky funnel
edges.risk_of_conflict: scaling acquisition over a leaky bucket wastes budget
edges.example: fix the activation/retention leak before scaling acquisition spend
edges.resolution_rule: retention-first dominates when churn is above the threshold

conflict_axes.trigger: fixed budget must split between fast paid demand capture and slow-compounding organic
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: allocate by payback horizon and marginal ROAS; protect a minimum organic investment so future CAC does not balloon
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: organic is starved for multiple cycles and blended CAC trends up
conflict_axes.example: cutting all content to fund a paid push spikes CAC two quarters later

conflict_axes.trigger: growth targets demand volume while payback ceilings cap profitable spend
resolution_order: scale only while above the payback ceiling
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: unit economics ceilings dominate volume targets; spend only while marginal ROAS clears the payback threshold
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: marginal spend runs below payback ceiling to hit a volume number
conflict_axes.example: hitting a lead target by buying leads below payback destroys contribution margin

conflict_axes.trigger: a conversion-winning variant drifts from on-brand positioning or claims
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: positioning and claim limits are hard bounds; CRO/creative optimize only inside them
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a winning variant requires an off-brand or unsubstantiated claim
conflict_axes.example: a clickbait hook lifts CTR but misrepresents the product and erodes trust

conflict_axes.trigger: targeting, claims, or tracking that boost performance approach legal/policy red lines
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: compliance and consent red lines are absolute and dominate any performance gain
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a tactic needs non-consented data or an unsubstantiated claim
conflict_axes.example: using non-consented signals for retargeting risks fines and platform bans

conflict_axes.trigger: churn is high but pressure exists to scale acquisition spend now
resolution_order: fix the leak if above threshold
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: when churn exceeds the threshold, retention work dominates new acquisition spend
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: acquisition scales while early-cohort retention is below target
conflict_axes.example: pouring budget into a funnel that loses 80% of users in week one

conflict_axes.trigger: pressure to call winners fast versus waiting for adequate statistical power
resolution_order: pre-set sample size and stopping rule
hold decisions until power is met
ship trivial changes without full tests
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: for material decisions, validity dominates speed; only low-risk changes may ship without full power
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: a high-impact change is rolled out on an underpowered or peeked test
conflict_axes.example: declaring a landing-page winner on day two then seeing the lift vanish

conflict_axes.trigger: platform last-click numbers disagree with incrementality/source-of-truth reads
resolution_order: reconcile against the source of truth
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: the reconciled source of truth and incrementality dominate platform-reported conversions for budget decisions
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: budget is shifted on platform-reported ROAS that incrementality contradicts
conflict_axes.example: retargeting shows huge last-click ROAS but near-zero incremental lift in a holdout

conflict_axes.trigger: broad reach for scale versus tight targeting/message-match for efficiency
resolution_order: start from the ICP and message-match
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: expand breadth only while CPA stays within target; ICP message-match dominates blind reach
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: broad targeting raises CPA above the threshold to chase volume
conflict_axes.example: a broad lookalike scales spend but doubles CPA versus the core audience

conflict_axes.trigger: automated bidding optimizes to a signal that may be noisy or mis-tracked
resolution_order: let automation run on a clean signal
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: automated bidding is trusted only on a verified signal; a broken signal forces human override
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: automated bidding scales spend against a tracking outage or proxy event
conflict_axes.example: smart bidding floods budget after a conversion tag fires on every pageview by mistake

edge_cases.trigger: budget is reallocated on last-click platform ROAS
edge_cases.example: retargeting takes budget for conversions that would happen anyway
edge_cases.detection_method: compare platform-reported ROAS against a holdout/incrementality read
resolution: move budget on incrementality, not last-click
flag channels with low incremental lift

edge_cases.trigger: a site change breaks a conversion tag silently
edge_cases.example: a redeploy drops the purchase event and bidding goes haywire
edge_cases.detection_method: monitor conversion-volume anomalies and tag health checks against expected baselines

edge_cases.trigger: a winner is declared before reaching the planned sample size
edge_cases.example: a CRO test called on day two reverses when fully powered
edge_cases.detection_method: check each shipped test against its pre-set sample size and stopping rule
resolution: require sample-size and stopping-rule compliance before rollout

edge_cases.trigger: a winning ad keeps running until frequency saturates
edge_cases.failure_mode: CPA degrades as the creative fatigues
edge_cases.example: a top ad's CPA doubles after weeks of unchanged delivery
edge_cases.detection_method: track frequency and CPA trend per creative against fatigue thresholds

edge_cases.trigger: acquisition spend scales while retention is below target
edge_cases.example: scaling ads on a funnel that loses most users in week one
edge_cases.detection_method: compare cohort retention/payback against thresholds before scaling spend

edge_cases.trigger: a high-performing creative makes an unsubstantiated claim
edge_cases.example: a 'guaranteed results' ad with no evidence triggers a platform ban
edge_cases.detection_method: check each public claim against the approved-claims register and a substantiation source

edge_cases.trigger: tracking or retargeting uses data without valid consent
edge_cases.example: firing analytics and ad pixels before consent is granted
edge_cases.detection_method: audit tag firing against consent state and opt-out handling

edge_cases.trigger: ad promise does not match the landing page
edge_cases.failure_mode: high bounce and wasted ad spend
edge_cases.example: an ad for a discount lands on a generic homepage
edge_cases.detection_method: audit ad-to-page message match and post-click bounce/conversion rates
resolution: align page to the ad promise
route each ad to a matched page

edge_cases.failure_mode: effort spent where it does not move the north star
edge_cases.example: celebrating impressions and likes while conversions are flat
edge_cases.detection_method: trace each tracked metric to a funnel stage and the north-star metric
resolution: report stage conversion and the north star

edge_cases.trigger: high-volume keywords are targeted regardless of intent
edge_cases.example: ranking for an informational term that never buys
edge_cases.detection_method: classify each target keyword by intent and check downstream conversion

edge_cases.trigger: automated bidding scales against a mis-tracked event
edge_cases.failure_mode: budget floods to a false signal
edge_cases.example: smart bidding overspends after a tag fires on every pageview
edge_cases.detection_method: validate the conversion signal feeding automated bidding before and during scaling

dominance_rules.trigger: spend would scale past the payback ceiling to hit a volume target
dominance_rules.rule: marginal spend must clear the payback/LTV:CAC ceiling; volume targets never justify unprofitable marginal spend
dominance_rules.required_action: cap BUDGET_BIDDING at the marginal break-even set by UNIT_ECONOMICS
dominance_rules.example: refuse to buy leads below payback to hit a monthly lead number

dominance_rules.trigger: a high-performing tactic nears a legal/policy red line
dominance_rules.rule: consent, privacy, and claim-substantiation red lines are absolute and override any performance gain
dominance_rules.required_action: block the tactic and route to MARKETING_GOVERNANCE/human review
dominance_rules.example: kill an unsubstantiated 'guaranteed results' ad despite strong CTR

dominance_rules.trigger: a material change is pushed to ship before a test reaches power
dominance_rules.rule: material optimization decisions require adequate statistical power before rollout
dominance_rules.required_action: hold the decision until AB_TESTING_EXPERIMENT power and guardrails are met
dominance_rules.example: do not ship a landing-page winner declared on day-two noise

dominance_rules.trigger: platform last-click contradicts the reconciled/incrementality read
dominance_rules.rule: budget decisions use the reconciled source of truth and incrementality, not platform last-click
dominance_rules.required_action: reallocate on PERFORMANCE_ANALYTICS incrementality reads and flag platform over-credit
dominance_rules.example: ignore retargeting's inflated last-click ROAS when a holdout shows near-zero lift

dominance_rules.trigger: churn exceeds threshold while acquisition spend is being scaled
dominance_rules.rule: when retention is below target, fixing the leak dominates scaling new acquisition
dominance_rules.required_action: pause scaling and prioritize ACTIVATION_RETENTION until payback clears
dominance_rules.example: stop a paid push on a funnel that loses most users in week one

dominance_rules.trigger: a high-value channel is ready before its prerequisites
dominance_rules.rule: do not finalize a node before its true prerequisites are reviewed, even if it is high value
dominance_rules.required_action: block paid scale until measurement, messaging, and matched pages exist
dominance_rules.example: refuse to scale paid search before conversion tracking is verified

dominance_rules.trigger: an irreversible or high-risk commitment is requested before validation
dominance_rules.rule: high-risk or irreversible decisions require validation and human review proportional to risk before lock
dominance_rules.required_action: block hard lock until acceptance tests and human review pass
dominance_rules.example: hold a major always-on budget commitment until economics and tracking are validated

dominance_rules.trigger: a confident-looking score lacks eligible evidence
dominance_rules.rule: evidence-label correctness dominates numeric precision; unsupported values stay heuristic
dominance_rules.required_action: keep all estimates heuristic and set observed fields to 0.0 with no observed labels
dominance_rules.example: do not label a CAC estimate 'observed' without an eligible measured dataset

dominance_rules.trigger: an artifact is proposed for lock before checks pass
dominance_rules.rule: QA and acceptance gates dominate the urge to lock an artifact
dominance_rules.required_action: keep lifecycle in draft/soft_lock until validation_report passes
dominance_rules.example: leave the budget plan soft-locked until payback and tracking gates pass

dominance_rules.rule: schema and formula consistency dominate adding more objects
dominance_rules.required_action: reduce optional density before allowing any formula or reference inconsistency
dominance_rules.example: trim a weak similarity edge rather than exceed the dense edge cap with a broken score

anti_rework_rules.rule: fix the strategy frame and primary KPI before any channel build
anti_rework_rules.rationale: channels optimized to no objective or the wrong KPI are pure rework
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: campaign or content work starts before the brief names a primary KPI
anti_rework_rules.example: launching ads before deciding what a good outcome is

anti_rework_rules.rule: verify measurement, attribution, and consent before scaling spend
anti_rework_rules.rationale: optimizing and scaling on broken or non-compliant tracking corrupts every later decision
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: spend scales while conversion tracking is unverified
anti_rework_rules.example: scaling paid social before the conversion API/tag is confirmed

anti_rework_rules.rule: ground topics and keywords in measured intent before producing content or keyword ad lists
anti_rework_rules.rationale: content and keyword lists built without demand data go unread or unconverted
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: writing or keyword buying begins with no intent map
anti_rework_rules.example: publishing a content sprint on guessed topics

anti_rework_rules.rule: fix the messaging framework before producing creative, pages, or content at scale
anti_rework_rules.rationale: off-message creative and pages must be redone once positioning is settled
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: creative or page copy is produced before the value prop is agreed
anti_rework_rules.example: shipping ads whose hook contradicts the positioning

anti_rework_rules.rule: model the funnel and locate the bottleneck before choosing what to optimize
anti_rework_rules.rationale: optimizing a non-bottleneck stage yields no movement on the north star
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: experiments or budget target a stage that is not the bottleneck
anti_rework_rules.example: A/B testing button color while activation is the real leak

anti_rework_rules.rule: compute unit economics and set payback ceilings before scaling budget
anti_rework_rules.rationale: scaling before economics are known funds unprofitable marginal spend that must be unwound
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: budget scales with no CPA/ROAS ceiling tied to payback
anti_rework_rules.example: doubling spend without knowing the LTV:CAC ceiling

anti_rework_rules.rule: reach pre-set sample size before declaring an experiment winner
anti_rework_rules.rationale: calling winners on noise ships changes that reverse and must be rolled back
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: a winner is declared before the planned sample size
anti_rework_rules.example: stopping a CRO test early because it looks good on day two

anti_rework_rules.rule: fix activation/retention leaks before scaling acquisition spend
blocked_until: retention above threshold or leak owned
anti_rework_rules.rationale: scaling acquisition over a leaky bucket wastes budget that retention work would save
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: acquisition scales while early-cohort retention is below target
anti_rework_rules.example: pouring budget into a funnel with severe week-one churn

anti_rework_rules.rule: pass acceptance tests and human review before hard-locking high-risk artifacts
anti_rework_rules.rationale: hard-locking before checks pass forces a costly change-control reversal
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: a high-risk node is hard-locked with no acceptance tests
anti_rework_rules.example: locking the budget plan before payback and tracking gates pass

anti_rework_rules.rule: define the source registry before assigning evidence labels
anti_rework_rules.rationale: labeling values before sources exist invites unsupported observed claims
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: an observed/experimental label appears with no eligible source
anti_rework_rules.example: tagging a heuristic CAC as observed with no dataset

iteration_protocol.trigger: validator or performance review reports a failure
iteration_protocol.detection: compare validation_report and KPI dashboards against thresholds
acceptance_tests: every failure mapped to a subsystem

iteration_protocol.trigger: multiple defects or underperforming areas compete for attention
iteration_protocol.detection: rank by risk*irreversibility and bottleneck leverage
action: score defects by risk and leverage
acceptance_tests: highest risk/leverage items first
iteration_protocol.stop_condition: queue empty or only sub-threshold low-risk items remain

iteration_protocol.trigger: a change touches a high-coupling or locked node
iteration_protocol.detection: trace dependents and downstream edges of the changed node
acceptance_tests: all dependents of the change identified
iteration_protocol.stop_condition: impact set stable across a pass

iteration_protocol.trigger: a defect is assigned for repair
iteration_protocol.detection: map failure type to the responsible subsystem via repair_routing
action: route each defect to its owner
acceptance_tests: each defect routed and addressed

iteration_protocol.trigger: repairs were applied to scores, refs, or high-coupling nodes
iteration_protocol.detection: re-run kb_validator and metrics after every repair batch
acceptance_tests: validator exit code is 0
iteration_protocol.stop_condition: validator passes with no new failures

iteration_protocol.trigger: new evidence or a measured outcome changes a node's importance
iteration_protocol.detection: recompute posterior_importance when evidence confidence shifts past the delta
action: recompute posterior via the no-observed-data formula until data exists
acceptance_tests: posterior matches the active formula within tolerance
iteration_protocol.stop_condition: no posterior shifts above the revisit delta

iteration_protocol.trigger: a high-risk or irreversible decision or an ethics/compliance red line is reached
iteration_protocol.detection: check risk/irreversibility and governance flags against escalation thresholds
action: route to human review with a decision record
acceptance_tests: human approval recorded before proceeding

iteration_protocol.trigger: repair iterations are not reducing failures or only low-risk defects remain
acceptance_tests: residual defects are all sub-threshold low-risk
iteration_protocol.stop_condition: failure-count delta below materiality or max iterations hit
